result.topic_en: Norms of cyclotomic integers built from fifth roots of unity ε, expressed through the sums of squared differences p', p''. The page also has golden-ratio values (sin 72/sin 36), logarithmic computations for angles that are multiples of 360°/7, and pencil algebra on the expression (a+b+c)^3−27abc.
